issues.title: Route params with an encoded slash are decoded twice
issues.body: GET /files/a%252Fb gives req.params.name === 'a/b' but the docs say one decoding. Version 4.3, node 22. Failing case in test/params.js is attached.

issues.title: Add an option to let app.listen bind a unix socket path
issues.body: app.listen(path) works by accident. Please make it documented and tested: app.listen({ path }).

issues.title: The routing guide never mentions that mounted apps see a stripped url
issues.body: docs/guide/routing.md says req.url is untouched under app.use('/api', sub). It is stripped; req.originalUrl is the full one.

issues.title: How do I read the raw body in an error handler?
issues.body: I use express.json() and my error handler needs the bytes that failed to parse. Is there a supported way?

issues.title: Server hangs sometimes
issues.body: It hangs. Please fix.

issues.title: res.sendFile ignores the dotfiles option for nested paths
issues.body: Setting dotfiles: 'deny' blocks /.env but not /a/.env. Node 22, Linux. Reproduction repo linked.

issues.title: trust proxy gives me a different address than the docs say
issues.body: Behind our proxy, req.ip is not the address I expected from the docs ('the client's address'). Is that how trust proxy is meant to work?

issues.title: Typo in the res.redirect example
issues.body: The status table row for 308 reads 'Permanant Redirect'. One word in docs/api/response.md.

issues.title: Support async route handlers that return a promise
issues.body: A rejected promise from a handler is not passed to next(err). Other routers do this; could we?

issues.title: Does not work
issues.body: I upgraded and it does not work anymore.

issues.title: Expose the matched route pattern as req.routePath
issues.body: Metrics middleware wants the pattern ('/users/:id'), not the URL. Today it is only on req.route.path inside the handler.

issues.title: res.json with a BigInt throws a confusing error
issues.body: res.json({ id: 1n }) throws 'Do not know how to serialize a BigInt'. Please make this an error that names res.json, or support a replacer for it.

issues.title: Why does app.get('/') run before my app.use('/') middleware?
issues.body: I registered middleware second and it ran second, as expected. But the docs example registers it first. Am I misreading the order?

issues.title: The cookie options table lacks the partitioned attribute
issues.body: res.cookie accepts partitioned since 4.2 (lib/response.js line 6) but the table in docs/api/cookie.md does not list it.

issues.title: req.query parser option 'simple' drops repeated keys
issues.body: With 'query parser': 'simple' (lib/query.js), ?a=1&a=2 gives a: '2'. The extended parser gives an array. The docs do not say the simple one keeps the last.

issues.title: Allow app.set('etag', fn) to receive the response status
issues.body: Weak etags for 206 responses should be skipped; the function only gets the body today.

issues.title: Some requests return a 500 in production
issues.body: Some requests give a 500 in production, never locally. Node version unknown, no logs.

issues.title: Sub-app error handlers do not run for errors thrown in a parent's param callback
issues.body: router.param callbacks of the parent throw; the sub-app's four-argument handler never sees it. Failing test attached.

prs.title: route param errors to the nearest handler

issues.title: Document the order of res.format handlers
issues.body: res.format (docs/api/response.md) picks the first match in object key order. The reference should say so, with an example where order matters.

issues.title: Can app.param take an array of names?
issues.body: app.param(['id','uid'], fn) works in 4.x by accident? I could not find it in the docs.

files.lib/params.js:
// decodes a matched param; callers pass the raw segment
export const decodeParam = (raw) => decodeURIComponent(decodeURIComponent(raw));
files.lib/listen.js:
// listen(port | path | options)
export function listen(app, ...args) { return app.server.listen(...args); }
files.docs/guide/routing.md:
# Routing

A mounted app receives req.url unchanged.
files.lib/send-file.js:
// only the last segment is checked
export const hidden = (path) => path.split('/').pop().startsWith('.');
files.lib/proxy.js:
// walks X-Forwarded-For from the right until a hop is not trusted
export const clientIp = (hops, trusted) => hops.findLast((hop) => !trusted(hop));

## res.format(object)
Performs content negotiation on the Accept header.
files.lib/layer.js:
// handle_request calls fn(req, res, next) and ignores the return value
export function handleRequest(layer, req, res, next) { layer.handle(req, res, next); }
files.lib/route.js:
// req.route is set when a route matches
export const match = (req, route) => { req.route = route; };

// etag(body, encoding) -> string
export const etag = (body, encoding) => hash(body, encoding);

files.lib/application.js:
// param(name | names[], fn): arrays are flattened
export function param(app, names, fn) { [].concat(names).forEach((name) => app.router.param(name, fn)); }
